**Class** in the `Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium](/docs/reference/#latiprimererenderingpdfium) package.

```csharp
public sealed class PdfiumOptions
```

Limits on the PDFs [PdfiumRasterizer](/docs/reference/latiprimere-rendering-pdfium/pdfiumrasterizer/) opens and renders, for applications that print PDFs from anyone, such as a web application's users.

## Constructors

```csharp
public PdfiumOptions()
```

## Properties

### MaxDocumentBytes

```csharp
public int MaxDocumentBytes { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the longest PDF opened, in bytes. Defaults to [PdfiumOptions.DefaultMaxDocumentBytes](/docs/reference/latiprimere-rendering-pdfium/pdfiumoptions/#defaultmaxdocumentbytes).

The whole PDF is held in memory while it is open, so a lower limit bounds what one document can take. A longer one is refused with a [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/) before more than the limit is read, and before PDFium sees any of it.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): The value is zero or negative.

### RenderTimeout

```csharp
public TimeSpan RenderTimeout { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the longest a band of a page may take to render, or [Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.timeout.infinitetimespan) for no limit. Defaults to [PdfiumOptions.DefaultRenderTimeout](/docs/reference/latiprimere-rendering-pdfium/pdfiumoptions/#defaultrendertimeout).

A PDF can be made to keep a renderer busy for as long as its author likes, and only one PDF renders at a time in a process, as PDFium isn't thread-safe; so without a limit, one such PDF would hold up every other. When the limit runs out, the band is abandoned with a [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/), and the next rendering can start.

PDFium checks the time between the steps of drawing a page, so a single step that takes long, such as decoding one huge image, can overrun it. Reading a page's content, when it is first rendered, isn't counted.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): The value is not positive, other than [Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.threading.timeout.infinitetimespan), or is longer than a year.

## Fields

### DefaultMaxDocumentBytes

```csharp
public static readonly int DefaultMaxDocumentBytes
```

The default longest PDF opened: 2,147,483,647 bytes, about 2 GB, the most PDFium can read from memory here.

### DefaultRenderTimeout

```csharp
public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultRenderTimeout
```

The default longest a band of a page may take to render: 2 minutes.
